info.name: Gift Recommendation Agent
info.description:
Full API collection for the Gift Recommendation Agent.

Workflow:
1. POST /api/workflow/run  →  get thread_id
2. GET  /api/workflow/:id/stream  (or poll /api/workflow/:id)
3. GET  /api/workflow/:id/steps   to inspect each agent step
4. POST /api/workflow/:id/review  to approve/reject/edit/regenerate

request.description: Check if the API is running and see how many runs are active.
Start a workflow for Aarav Mehta. Returns immediately with thread_id. Copy the thread_id into the collection variable.
Paste the contents of data/contacts.json inside the "contacts" array.

formdata.description: Set src to your contacts.json path

request.description: Upload the contacts.json file directly. Starts a workflow for every contact in the file.
Get a summary of every workflow run in this session.
Full structured output: signals, search trace, gifts, review status, errors.
Returns every node's output in execution order. Great for debugging the agent's reasoning.
What gifting signals did the agent extract from the LinkedIn profile? Shows strong signals, weak (inferred) signals, and sensitive attributes that were excluded.
All products found via DuckDuckGo. Shows search queries used, which products came from trusted e-commerce domains, and extracted prices.
The top-3 ranked gift recommendations with confidence scores, risk levels, reasoning, and personalised messages.
Complete execution trace: every step, retry count, all warnings/errors, and the thread_id this was regenerated from (if applicable).

item.name: SSE stream (open in browser or Postman)

request.description:
Server-Sent Events stream. Emits one JSON event per node completion.

Event types:
- type:step   — node completed (includes output summary)
- type:status — status changed
- type:done   — workflow paused for review or finished
- type:error  — workflow failed

Note: Postman supports SSE — open the request, click Send, and watch the response stream in real time.
